validation_reports_all.statement: An invoice with several defects (missing customer name, bad quantity, negative price, bad tax rate, bad discount) yields one error per defect, all returned together, each with its field path.

money_rounding.statement: Half-cent values round up (e.g. 3 x 0.125 = 0.38, tax 8.25% on 10.10 = 0.83), totals are Decimal-exact, and grand total = subtotal - discount + tax.

text_output.statement: The text output lists customer, each item with quantity, unit price and line total, then subtotal, discount, tax and total lines.

json_output.statement: The JSON export parses with json.loads and carries the same computed amounts as two-decimal strings.

cli_exit_codes.statement: The CLI exits 0 on a valid file and 2 with all errors on stderr on invalid JSON, a missing file or validation errors.

single_file_stdlib.statement: invoice_gen.py is the only module of the tool and imports only standard library modules.
